title: No named client or measured outcome appears anywhere checked
statement: The subject names no client or measured outcome anywhere checked, while both qualified comparisons name specific clients with measured results.
implication: A prospect comparing three firms sees concrete proof on two of them and none on this one.
audience_relevance: Prospective clients evaluating advisors before a first call are the ones weighing this directly.

title: The firm does not appear on the first page of results for its own specialism
statement: A prospect searching for the firm’s specialism and region does not see the firm on the first page of results.
implication: A prospect who does not already know the firm by name or referral is unlikely to find it through a direct search.
audience_relevance: A prospect with no referral relationship, searching cold, is the one this affects.
